title: Figures 9-10: Far-field super-lens (FSL) and tomographic multi-beam holography schematics
description: Figure 9 combines a schematic of far-field/near-field geometry and a microscope setup with small image panels (b-f) of grating and object images, captioned "FSL Based on an Indefinite Permittivity Metamaterial Placed Between the Object and the Image-Releasing Grating." Figure 10 shows Beams A and B scattering through an "Indefinite Permittivity Medium" grating toward Detectors A and B, alongside a spectrum diagram labeled "Far field", "1st order" and "2-nd order" against wavenumber k. Caption: "Figure 10. Tomographic Multi-Beam Multi-Detector Holography of Sub-Wavelength Objects Using Indefinite Permittivity Medium (IPM)."
